title: AC internal resourcing ? Park ? lead replies ? case back in the same agent's Assigned Cases | APPR | Controllable (Code 96 � Operations Control) | Delay 6 to under 9 hrs| 1 Pax | 1 Leg | Basic Aeroplan
description:
Checks the park cycle for internal resourcing. Flight AC 412 YUL ? YYZ arrived 7 hours late. Trip Tracer shows Code 96 (Controllable), and DDS returns FD-APPR-EL-02, CAD 700. In the chat, the customer said the gate agent blamed the weather. The customer leaves the chat before payment. Agent Sarah Martin doesn't want to pay out while the coding is in doubt, and she can't change the code herself. She chooses New Resourcing and asks the lead pool to confirm the code. A lead task is created, the case parks and the "Case Escalated" alert is shown. Lead Nadia Bouchard checks and confirms Code 96, then submits her resourcing notes. The case changes to "Update Pending Action" and appears in Sarah's Assigned Cases list with "?? UPDATE RECEIVED". It does not go to To Be Assigned and no other agent can take it. Sarah opens it (In Progress), keeps the decision and sends "Decision Rendered � Action Required" with the deep link. The customer lives in Canada and picks Cash, so payment goes by Interac and only the email is collected. The customer isn't contacted while the case is parked.

Prerequisites:
PNR: PK001 � single passenger Nicolas Fortier (Adult, Basic Aeroplan 9876543210, good standing). AC 412 YUL ? YYZ, July 20, 2026. Scheduled arrival 12:00, actual 19:00 (7h delay). Code 96 (Operations Control � Controllable). Travelled, arrived late. No VOL/INVOL changes. AC only. Claim filed Jul 28, 2026. Case reference: CASE-FD-20260728-001. No duplicate. CyberSource GREEN. Country of residence: Canada. Owner agent: Sarah Martin (Agent role, Available). Lead: Nadia Bouchard (Lead role, in the lead pool). Second agent: Marc Dubois (Available). Resourcing sent: Aug 1, 10:00. Lead replies: Aug 3, 14:00.
